description: Propose a generation for the user to confirm: validates the parameters against the catalog, computes the price, and shows a card (widget hosts) or returns the same object as text. NOTHING runs until lab_run_proposal is called with the returned vorschlag_id — by the card's button, or by you after the user said yes. Without a measured price there is no vorschlag_id and no button: the answer then says so instead of offering an estimate as if it were a quote. Free.

aspect_ratio.description: Image: aspect ratio as W:H, from the model's aspect_ratios in lab_list_models.

audio_url.description: Video: URL of an existing audio track to lay under the clip. Independent of generate_audio.

camera_motion.description: Video: Structured camera move sent to the model itself — only models whose lab_list_models entry lists camera_motions. Prefer this over prose when a keyframe chain must MOVE rather than cross-fade.

character_refs.description: Character ids (from lab_list_characters) whose reference image locks the cast's identity. Counted against the model's max_references and shown on the card by name.

duration_seconds.description: Video: clip length in seconds, inside the model's duration grid from lab_list_models. The card shows the DELIVERED seconds and says so when the provider snaps.

end_image_id.description: Video: the completed image to land the clip on (last frame). Only where lab_list_models says supports_end_frame.

generate_audio.description: Video: ask for the model's native audio. Only meaningful where lab_list_models says audio: schaltbar.

in_sec.description: Video: start of the excerpt cut out of the reference clip, in seconds. Only together with out_sec and source_video_id.

intent.description: Video intent from the routing rules. Used to choose a model when tool is omitted and retained for Plan B; an explicit tool wins.

kind.description: Which kind of generation to propose

location_id.description: Location board id (from lab_list_locations) — anchors the shot in the same place.

out_sec.description: Video: end of the excerpt in the reference clip, in seconds. Must lie behind in_sec.

prompt.description: What to generate. The user can edit it on the card; lab_run_proposal takes the edited text as prompt_override without a new proposal.

referenzen.description: Video, clip path (source_video_id): typed references. The position IS the address — first image @Image1, first extra clip @Video2, first sound @Audio1. Image references are measured before sending and scaled up to the model's minimum rather than rejected.

art.description: Which channel this reference goes into: bild an image, video a clip, ton a sound. How many of each a model takes is in lab_list_models (referenz_grenzen); a channel the model has no slot for is rejected before a card is even offered.

id.description: The reference as an ID, looked up in this project: an image id, a video id, an audio id, or an asset key. The URL is never built here.

rolle.description: WHICH character or place this reference means. Free text, carried through.

url.description: Address of the reference. Exactly one of url or id.

resolution.description: Resolution tier, exactly as listed for the model in lab_list_models. Omit for the model's default.

scene_ref.description: Scene label (e.g. 'SZ 04'). Stored on the row, so the result can be matched back to a shot list.

seed_image_url.description: Image: run img-to-img guided by this existing image URL. Shown on the card as the 'before'.

source_image_id.description: Video: the completed image to animate (positive integer as string). Required for a video proposal — unless source_video_id proposes a clip instead.

source_video_id.description: Video: propose a run FROM A CLIP instead of a still — a generated video id (lab_animate/lab_job_status) or an asset key (lab_list_assets). Mutually exclusive with source_image_id; only for models that take a video reference (lab_list_models says v2v).

tool.description: Model id, copied verbatim from lab_list_models. Omit to use the default for this kind — the card names it and prices it either way.

variants.description: Image: how many variants (default 1). Multiplies the price — the card shows the multiplication.

name: lab_propose
title: Propose Generation
